svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI EVALUATION CI/CD PIPELINE & LLM-AS-A-JUDGE CALIBRATION
Stop 1–10 Likert Judge Bias: Binary Rubrics + Position-Swap + 90s CI Gate Hits 96.8% Alignment
1,200 PRs/Mo / 2,000 Golden Cases: Tier 1 1–10 Likert Judge (69% Human Match, 44m CI) vs. Tier 2 BLEU/ROUGE vs. Tier 4 ($19K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Likert Bias & 44-Min PR Gates
1. Uncalibrated `1–10 Likert` LLM-as-a-Judge (31.0% Bias Error):
• Scores cluster blindly around `7–8/10`; rewards verbose flowery
hallucinations (+24% verbosity bias) & Option A (+18% position bias)
2. Running All 2,000 Frontier Judge Calls on Every PR (44.0 Min):
• 8,000 judge calls per PR blocks CI for 44 minutes ($135/PR)—so
developers bypass `--no-verify` and ship regressions!
3. Classical BLEU / ROUGE-L Overlap Only (Tier 2: 42.5% Error):
• Fails valid paraphrased answers & misses negated factual flips
Production Failure Impact (1,200 PRs/Mo / 2,000 Golden Cases):
• Human Expert Agreement: Only 69.0% (Tier 1) | 57.5% (Tier 2)
• PR CI Wait Duration: 44.0 Min (Tier 1) | 180.0 Min (Tier 3 Manual)
• Monthly Judge Token & Escaped Bug TCO: $165,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Binary Rubric + Position-Swap + 2-Speed CI
1. Atomic `Yes/No` Binary Checklists + A/B Position-Swap:
• Replaces vague 1–10 scales with 4 boolean criteria + bilateral
`(A,B)` & `(B,A)` swap check + Rogan-Gladen correction (96.8% match!)
2. 80% Deterministic Code & Local NLI Asserts (`0.2ms–28ms`):
• Checks JSON schema, tool args, numbers & HHEM-2.1 entailment
without calling a Frontier Judge (cuts judge token bill by 80%!)
3. Two-Speed CI Funnel (`1.5m` 150-Case PR Gate + Nightly 2,000):
• Stratified hard-case PR smoke gate finishes in 90 seconds ($0.45/PR)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Human Expert Agreement: 96.8% (Cohen's Kappa = 0.91)
• PR CI Gate Latency: 1.5 Min (29.3x faster) | Bias Error: 3.2%
• Monthly Total TCO: $19,000 / mo (-88.5% savings vs. Tier 1)
